notes.title: 無料Demoバージョンが公開されました！
notes.notes:
Hello, I am developer.

The playable demo version has recently been released! Check out what kind of adventure the protagonist "Ava" will embark on with her little friend "Dra"! It supports Korean, Japanese, and English, and the playtime is about 1 hour. (After launching the game, please change Language (Some text) and Language to English in the Options.)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3247090/?snr=1_5_9__205

We would be delighted if you enjoy it and leave a review on the game page.

Have a great day!
